children.label: financial_resources
children.description: Financial resources encompass the monetary contributions and funding mechanisms used to support humanitarian efforts, including grants, donations, and budget allocations.

children.label: human_resources
children.description: Human resources refer to the personnel and volunteers involved in humanitarian activities, including skilled professionals, local community members, and international aid workers.

children.label: material_goods
children.description: Material goods include essential supplies and equipment necessary for humanitarian relief, such as food, water, shelter materials, and medical supplies.

children.label: technical_assistance
children.description: Technical assistance involves the provision of specialized skills and expertise to support humanitarian operations, including engineering, healthcare, and logistics services.

children.label: information_systems
children.description: Information systems are the technological and data management tools used to coordinate and optimize humanitarian responses, including communication networks, databases, and monitoring platforms.
